title: Normalized common strict-tower model data for completed pullbacks
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a scheme isomorphism $h:U\simeq T$ on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For $n\geq1$ put $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ and $R_{E,W}=\lim_n(A_{E,n})_W$ on these sites; use these completed coefficient rings [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], their quotient-normalized coefficient identity [def-fd-coefficient-comparison-datum], the derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and the common full integral constructible categories [lem-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-characterization]. A common strict-tower model is a tuple of the following data, asserting no existence. It records invertibility of the completed coefficient structure map, exactness of ordinary pullback with its transported inverse-image action, and invertibility of its ordinary and strict-tower cochain counits [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Its strict tower is the actual PBC quotient reduction followed by finite pullback. It supplies a natural whole-tower isomorphism to the framework tower $Q_{h,E}(P)_n=\operatorname{Res}_n h_n^*(P\otimes A_{E,n})$ [def-pur-integral-derived-operations], pinned on quotient-unit generators. Its cone isomorphism is pinned by both the unshifted and shifted quotient projections. On flat-term K-flat representatives [def-pc-kflat-complex], it includes the derived tower identification equal to the composite of the defining reduction and pullback cochain counits. The Roos functor [def-weil-strict-roos-model] descends to derived towers, with a natural comparison to actual $R\lim$. For every K-injective resolution $q:X\to I$ with injective terms [def-pur-kinjective-complex], the comparison is $[H(q)][\iota_I]^{-1}$ followed by the canonical right-derived limit comparison, where $\iota_I$ has the limit tuple in its unshifted coordinate and zero shifted coordinate. Finally the tuple supplies the ambient framework-to-PBC strict-completion comparison [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], normalized by this cone and limit comparison, its actual-completion presentation on complete constructible inputs, the source/input/target constructibility witnesses, and its restriction to the full integral constructible categories with the specified ambient lift. The helper maps are the actual strict and derived towers, composite cochain counit, termwise-limit right-derived unit, the two framework quotient projections, and the unit generator. No quotient-level K-flatness is imposed.
